hosts.intro: Use if GitHub downloads fail, Telegram Web does not open or Discord takes long to start. Works through the hosts file.
hosts.audit.title: Check my hosts
hosts.list.title: GitHub, Telegram and Discord via verified addresses
hosts.preview.title: What will change in hosts
hosts.try.title: Try lines from a guide
hosts.try.intro: Paste lines like “address name”. Each is checked: whether the address responds, who owns it and whether it is needed at all. The hosts file is not changed.
hosts.try.write_note: Only “Helps” lines are written, as a separate “DpiShell user” block. They are checked once a day; a warning appears if an address stops working.
hosts.user.title: My lines in hosts
hosts.user.note: Written via “Try lines”. Outdated addresses are not removed automatically, only flagged.
hosts.audit.intro: Looks for other programs’ lines in hosts that keep sites from opening. Nothing changes until you select lines and click “Comment out”.
hosts.row.why.install: DNS address fails, this one works
hosts.row.why.bad_cert: another site responds at this address
hosts.row.why.owner_mismatch: the network belongs to another company ({owner})
hosts.confirm.remove_block: Remove DpiShell entries from the hosts file? Other lines in the file are not changed.
hosts.status.no_helper: The DpiShell helper will show the hosts file state.
hosts.status.block_empty: The DpiShell block in hosts is empty.
hosts.status.written: Addresses written: {n}. Checked once a day; outdated ones are removed automatically.
hosts.status.written_at: Addresses written: {n} ({date}, {time}). Checked once a day; outdated ones are removed automatically.
hosts.warn.lost: DpiShell entries disappeared from hosts — an antivirus (for example, Windows Defender) may have removed them. Click “Check addresses” and write again; if the antivirus asks, allow the change.
hosts.warn.damaged: The DpiShell block in hosts is damaged (it was edited manually). “Write” or “Revert” will fix it.
hosts.warn.foreign: hosts has another program’s entry for {host} — if the site does not open, it may be the cause.
hosts.warn.off_with_block: Turned off, but DpiShell entries remain in hosts (from a previous installation). To remove — “Revert”.
hosts.warn.stale: The address for {host} no longer works — remove the line or find a new address.
hosts.summary.nothing: Nothing to fix: everything opens already.
hosts.summary.to_install: Suitable addresses: {n}. The rest are not needed or failed the check.
hosts.preview.already: These addresses are already written — nothing to change.
hosts.confirm.write: The system hosts file will be changed: a DpiShell block of {n} lines will be added; other lines are not changed. A backup is saved. Windows Defender or another antivirus may show a warning (for example, HostsFileHijack) — this is a reaction to any hosts edit; allow the change (the button name depends on the version). Continue?
hosts.say.written: Addresses written: {n}. Checked once a day; outdated ones are removed automatically.
hosts.notify.stale_removed: The address for {host} is outdated and was removed from hosts.
hosts.notify.user_stale: The address for {host} no longer works — remove the line in “Network” → “Fix addresses” or find a new address.
hosts.notify.user_stale_n: Addresses that no longer work: {n} — “Network” → “Fix addresses”.
hosts.notify.several: Hosts recheck: there are changes — open “Network” → “Fix addresses”.
hosts.notify.lost: DpiShell entries disappeared from hosts (Windows Defender or another antivirus?). Open “Network” → “Fix addresses” to write them again.
hosts.try.reason.useless: Optimization is needed here, not hosts
hosts.try.reason.dangerous: The address belongs to someone else, not this site
hosts.try.simple.confirmed: confirmed: the site responds at this address
hosts.try.simple.foreign: another site responds at this address
hosts.try.tech.dns_same_net: from the same network as the DNS answer
hosts.tools_unavailable: These features need a newer helper — update it (one administrator prompt).
hosts.summary.try_empty: No lines like “address name” found. Example: 140.82.121.3 github.com
hosts.summary.skipped: Skipped lines without an address or name: {n}.
hosts.summary.first_n: Only the first lines were taken: {n}.
hosts.confirm.write_user: The system hosts file will be changed: a “DpiShell user” block of {n} lines will be added at the end (each line is marked dpishell-user); other lines are not changed. A backup is saved. Windows Defender or another antivirus may show a warning (for example, HostsFileHijack) — this is a reaction to any hosts edit; allow the change (the button name depends on the version). Continue?
hosts.say.user_written: Own lines written: {n}. “Revert” will remove them.
hosts.try.written_rejected: Lines written: {n}. Failed the repeat check: {list}.
hosts.confirm.remove_user: Remove these own lines from hosts? Other lines in the file are not changed.
hosts.audit.summary_empty: No other programs’ lines with site addresses in hosts.
hosts.audit.summary_bad: Problem lines: {n}. Select the ones to comment out — nothing is deleted. {summary}
hosts.confirm.comment: Lines in the hosts file that will become comments: {n}. “# DpiShell off” will be added before each; nothing is deleted. “Restore commented out” returns everything as it was. Windows Defender or another antivirus may show a warning — allow the change (the button name depends on the version). Continue?
hosts.say.commented_skipped: Lines commented out: {n}. Skipped: {skipped} (the file changed — check hosts again).
hosts.audit.commented: Lines commented out: {n}. To undo — “Restore commented out”.
hosts.confirm.restore: Restore hosts to its original state? DpiShell blocks and lines will be removed and lines commented out by DpiShell will be uncommented. Everything else in the file is not changed.
hosts.say.restored: hosts restored to its original state.
